meta.title: Atelier Kharita
meta.description: Tailoring and alterations in Beverwijk — expert repairs for trousers, jackets, dresses and curtains. Book your appointment online.

slides.subtitle: A broken zipper, a torn hem, a jacket that no longer fits the way it used to. Most people throw these pieces away and buy something new, but a good tailor can save almost anything. Bring it to us and let thirty five years of tailoring experience make it wearable again, at a fraction of the cost of replacing it.

That favorite piece sitting unworn in your closet does not have to end up forgotten in a drawer or thrown away for good. Maybe the fit changed, maybe a seam gave way, maybe it just needs a small adjustment to feel right again. Bring it to Atelier Kharita and we will repair it, adjust it, and give it a second life you will actually wear.

Every stitch carries thirty five years of tailoring experience, from a workshop in Syria to fittings across the Netherlands, including work with names like De Bijenkorf Amsterdam. That same precision and attention to detail goes into every hem, every seam, and every finish we deliver today, no matter how big or small the job.

about.title: About Us
about.paragraph:
Atelier Kharita is a tailoring and alterations studio built on craft and care. Whether it's shortening, taking in, or repairing trousers, jackets, dresses, or curtains, we treat every piece like it's worth keeping. Bring it in, and we'll give it a second life.

With 35 years of experience in the trade, Tarek Kharita is a craftsman through and through. His passion for tailor-made clothing and pattern design began in Syria, where he worked as a tailor from 1990 to 2015: from working for various companies to running his own business and a sewing workshop.

Since coming to the Netherlands, Tarek has continued his craftsmanship, including assignments for De Bijenkorf Amsterdam and at Atelier Shekho, where he handles clothing repairs and made-to-measure work.

What sets Tarek apart is his combination of craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a strong customer-focused approach. As an independent and solution-oriented entrepreneur, he delivers quality regardless of circumstances, whether it's a repair or a complete tailor-made garment. Tarek is fluent in Syrian Arabic and has a good command of Dutch and English, and is ready to make or repair your clothing with precision and care.
